'''2001 Melbourne Tournament''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament in Melbourne, Australia, on 28 January 2001.<ref name="dt-13376">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13376 Fluffy Pink Profit], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 4 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13376/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13376/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018055632/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13376/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 28 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
